capabilities: Look up EU regulations, directives and decisions by citation or CELEX number in 24 official EU languages
Retrieve article text from German, Austrian, Swiss, Spanish, Finnish, Italian and Dutch legal databases
Preview retrieved legal text and source metadata before inserting
Insert formatted citations into the active note only on explicit user confirmation
extras: The plugin was renamed from German Law Lookup at version 0.4.0; the plugin ID intentionally remains german-law-lookup for compatibility. The README warns the tool is not legal advice and that retrieved consolidated text is not marked authoritative.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to retrieve official legal text for EU or national legislation or produce source-aware citations for it.

relations.evidence: Official-source retrieval from EUR-Lex / Publications Office CELLAR
The German scope covers selected federal laws through the validated Gesetze im Internet provider path
The Austrian scope covers 24 explicitly mapped federal laws through RIS (Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes)
The Swiss scope covers article references for 23 explicitly mapped federal laws through Fedlex
Spanish discovery uses the official BOE (Boletín Oficial del Estado) consolidated-legislation service
Finlex supports consolidated statutes identified by number and year, such as 729/2018
Normattiva discovery searches act titles, for example Codice civile
BWB / Wetten.nl discovery searches by title or BWB identifier

summary: Legal lookup tool that retrieves EU and national law articles from official sources and inserts formatted citations into the active note.
